claims.text: Treat all sex partners at the same time; refer current partners for presumptive Tx
claims.quote: Concurrent treatment of all sex partners is vital for preventing reinfections. Current partners should be referred for presumptive therapy.
claims.locator: Workowski KA, et al. Sexually Transmitted Infections Treatment Guidelines, 2021. MMWR Recomm Rep. 2021;70(4):1-187 (PMC8344968)

claims.text: EPT may have a role where allowed by law
claims.quote: EPT might have a role in partner management for trichomoniasis
claims.locator: Workowski KA, et al. Sexually Transmitted Infections Treatment Guidelines, 2021. MMWR Recomm Rep. 2021;70(4):1-187 (PMC8344968)
